metadata.description: Agents, skills, commands, and scripts that give coding agents a full harness for game development: Unity, web and Capacitor, Roblox, Unreal, Godot, and Cocos Creator, plus design, platforms, monetization, analytics, multiplayer, QA, compliance, and production.
